content.short: maxAPY automates and optimizes DeFi yield farming 24/7 across 100+ strategies on 20+ protocols with single-asset vaults.
content.description: maxAPY serves as a meta-aggregator protocol that streamlines DeFi yield optimization across hundreds of carefully curated strategies. By leveraging sophisticated algorithms, it continually scans markets and allocates funds to the highest-yielding opportunities, compounds earnings automatically, and rebalances the portfolio to stay in the most profitable positions. Gas costs are taken into account to maximize efficiency. With a simple deposit, users earn returns on their assets.
